tasks.short: Supervise maintenance and repair of transportation systems

steps.what: Log the maintenance defect on the asset
Review the open repair queue
Set the repair priority and method
Direct the repair on site
Carry out the assigned repair
Sign the repair close-out
File the signed repair close-out

tasks.design: The maintenance lead logs asset id, defect, location and a safety flag on a {WORKFLOW} form. A {BI} queue shows open repairs. The transportation engineer sets the method and directs the work on site, then signs the close-out. Only that signed version is filed on the asset in {OPS_SYSTEM}. A model does not declare a safety repair fit to reopen.
tasks.previous_blocker: Defects arrived by phone and the close-out lived in a notebook, so a queue could not know which repair was signed.
tasks.enabler_now: Asset id and defect type can be required fields, so the queue and the close-out share one repair id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a road can reopen, and how the crew should work around live traffic, is still a site judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer sets the method and signs the close-out, including any safety repair.

ambition.what: Review the repair queue every week, not only when a crew calls

tasks.altitude: The queue replaces chasing notes. The engineer can refuse a close-out that has no signed method. Site direction does not shrink.

reach.task: Close the crew job only against the signed repair record
reach.learn: Which defects are signed, which are still open, and which are marked safety

evidence.claim: Supervising repairs in a mid-size firm is mostly site time and a written close-out. The queue is the part that can be a list.

Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act, with those duties from 2 December 2027. A model must not declare a repair safe. The transportation engineer still signs.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. Close-out measurements are copied from the crew form, not written by a model.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the signed close-out. The contractor's wrench time is supplier time and is not engineer time saved.

Input contract: asset id, defect type, location, reported date, safety flag, crew id. Producer is the maintenance lead. If the form is empty the engineer types the same fields from the call and marks the row manual.
Use the work-order list and the document approval that already exist before custom code. The queue records the asset and the defect, not a worker score.
The meeting and site prior fits this task. Directing the repair stays in person.
unknowns: Which assets have no stable id.
Who may sign a safety close-out when the engineer is away.
Whether the contractor can see the queue.
research_questions: What share of repairs is still reported only by phone?
How many open safety defects are older than a week?

already_counted.description: Engineer time setting the method stays in the remaining share
Site direction stays in the remaining share
Close-out judgement stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Keep defect types and safety flags aligned when a new asset class is added
Maintenance leads correct forms the queue rejects

approvals.approved_version: repair method signed for this defect id
repair close-out signed for this defect id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most defects still arrive by phone, so the queue stays thin and the engineer still directs every repair on site. The high case assumes the form is used, while every method choice and every close-out stays a signature. Crew hours are not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Model scenarios for development and transport problems

steps.what: Submit development trips for the scenarios
Check scenario inputs against the network

loop.output: gap list of missing trips or a wrong network id
loop.check: Each gap names a scenario id and a field that is empty or conflicting
loop.stop: One pass, then the engineer stops any scenario with no trip figure
loop.why_not_simpler: A demand story in prose does not match a network id by a fixed table

steps.what: Run the named model scenarios
Build the comparison from output rows
Draft the note on possible solutions

loop.input: comparison table and the note template
loop.output: prose that cites only cells in the table
loop.check: Every number in the note equals a cell in the comparison table
loop.stop: Drop any sentence with a number that has no cell, then stop
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason one solution is preferred is not a cell lookup

steps.what: Sign which scenario to take forward

tasks.design: The development planner submits zone, horizon, trips and network id on a {WORKFLOW} form. A run card on the {DATA_PLATFORM} launches only those scenarios. The comparison in {SPREADSHEET} copies output rows and nothing else. A bounded note in {DOCS} may describe the table, and any number that is not a cell is dropped. The transportation engineer signs the scenario to take forward. A finished run is not treated as a correct result.
tasks.previous_blocker: Demand assumptions sat in mail and printed plots, so a note could not show which output row a figure came from.
tasks.enabler_now: The model can export a scenario id and output rows that a table can key on.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the demand assumption is fair, and which problem is worth solving, remains a judgement. A run that finishes can still be the wrong network.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer accepts the demand basis and signs which scenario proceeds.

ambition.what: Re-run the signed scenario set when development trips change, not only at the first study

tasks.altitude: Retyping plots shrinks. The engineer can refuse a note whose figures are not on the output table, and can stop a run with no trip field.

reach.task: Revise the development trips the engineer marked unsupported
reach.learn: Which scenario id was signed and which output rows were blank

evidence.claim: Scenario work in a mid-size firm is a solver plus a written comparison. The hard part is the demand basis, not the formatting of the plot.
Digest [S11] reports a benchmark where a strategy produced executable simulation calls often, and executable was not the same as a correct result. A finished scenario run still needs the engineer.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. Model-written numbers are not filed. Every figure must match a solver output row.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. This design does not let a model pick a safety measure. The transportation engineer still signs.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when a signed scenario note is handed to the planner. Building the network from scratch is out of scope.

Input contract: zone id, horizon year, development trips, network id, demand source. Producer is the development planner. If trips or network id are missing, the run does not start and the row stays manual.
Use the model's own run card and export before custom code. The prior that this is mostly a meeting overstates the setup. The meeting is the choice at the end. Setup and runs are on the model screen.
A completed call to the solver is not evidence the scenario is right. No unattended change to a live signal or a safety device.
unknowns: Which model is the one of record.
Who owns the demand source when the planner and the engineer disagree.
Whether output rows include the units the note needs.
research_questions: What share of scenarios is rerun because the trip figure changed?
How often does a finished run fail a check the engineer applies by hand?

already_counted.description: Engineer still resolves demand gaps before a run
Engineer still checks the run log because a finished call can be wrong
The choice of scenario stays in the sign-off

incremental.description: Update the note template when a new output column appears
Planners correct trip forms the run card rejects

approvals.approved_version: scenario note signed for this scenario id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes trip figures stay in mail, so the run card rarely starts and the engineer still builds the comparison by hand. The high case assumes clean exports, while every demand check and every choice of scenario stays a signature. A finished run is not counted as saved judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect completed projects for environmental compliance

steps.what: Extract environmental conditions into a checklist

loop.output: checklist rows each with a condition id
loop.check: Every row cites a condition id that appears in the permit
loop.stop: One pass, then leave a blank row where no id is found
loop.why_not_simpler: Permit prose is not a fixed column set

steps.what: Flag drawing rows against the regulations
Inspect the completed project on site
Show the installed environmental measures
Write findings against the regulations

loop.output: findings that cite a condition id or a site note
loop.check: Every finding cites a condition id or a site note already written
loop.stop: Drop a sentence that cites neither, then stop
loop.why_not_simpler: What the engineer saw on site is not a field the permit already holds

steps.what: Sign the environmental compliance note

tasks.design: Permit conditions become a checklist in {DOCS}, and a coded check flags drawing rows that break a stated rule. The transportation engineer still walks the completed project and writes findings only from the checklist and the site notes. The signed compliance note is the version that is kept. A drawing flag is not a finding that the site complies.
tasks.previous_blocker: Permit packs were long scans, so the site visit started without a stable list of conditions to look for.
tasks.enabler_now: Conditions can be rows with an identifier, and drawing rules can be coded for the rows that are geometric.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the built work matches the condition still depends on looking at the site.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer walks the site and signs what complies and what does not.
tasks.altitude: Preparation of the checklist shrinks. The walk and the signature do not. The engineer can ignore a drawing flag that the site disproves.

reach.task: Fix only the findings the engineer signed
reach.learn: Which conditions are signed as open and which drawing flags were rejected on site

evidence.claim: Environmental close-out is a site walk against a permit. Reading the permit is document time. The walk is not.
Digest [S5] describes coded rule checks on a building model, for clashes and similar drawing rules. That can flag a drawing row. It does not decide that a finished site complies.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. Findings cite the checklist or the site note, not a model-written measurement.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the signed compliance note. Laboratory retests are a different task.

Input contract: project id, permit id, condition text, condition id, as-built drawing id. Producer is the permit file. If the pack is only a scan, the engineer marks the checklist manual and still walks the site.
Use the document checklist and the drawing-rule report that the model store can already run before custom code. The site prior is accepted: the walk stays in person.
This inspection does not file a cross-border waste shipment. That is a deconstruction task.
unknowns: Whether the as-built drawing is current.
Who signs when the engineer did not walk the site.
research_questions: What share of findings was invisible on the drawing and found only on site?
How often is the as-built drawing behind the built work?

already_counted.description: Engineer edits weak checklist rows before the visit
The site walk stays with the engineer
Signing what complies stays with the engineer

incremental.description: Add a checklist row when a permit type gains a new condition
Contractors resend drawings the flag list cannot open

approvals.approved_version: environmental compliance note signed for this project id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes permits stay as scans, so the checklist is typed by hand and the whole visit stays manual. The high case assumes a clean condition list and a drawing flag report, while the walk and the compliance signature stay with the engineer. Site time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Take part in contract bidding and administration

steps.what: Assemble the contract bid schedule
Issue the bidding pack to bidders
Return priced bids for the contract
Compare returned prices with the estimate
Hold the contract negotiation
Sign the contract bidder recommendation
Record contract administration notices

tasks.design: A bid schedule in {DOCS} is filled from signed quantities and clause ids. Returned prices land in a {SPREADSHEET} comparison that copies bidder figures only. The transportation engineer negotiates in the room and signs a bidder recommendation. Procurement records notices on the {PROCUREMENT} register. No draft awards the contract, and a drawing check is not used to score a bid.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantities, bids and negotiation notes were separate files, so the comparison was rebuilt by hand before every meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Item codes can join the signed quantity, the estimate and the returned rate.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions, risk and who is acceptable to do the work are still negotiated with people.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer negotiates the exceptions and signs who to recommend. Procurement awards.

ambition.what: Refresh the price comparison at each addendum, not only when the final bids return

tasks.altitude: Rebuilding the price table shrinks. The negotiation does not. The engineer can refuse a recommendation that cites a price not on the comparison.

reach.task: Award only against the signed bidder recommendation
reach.learn: Which item codes matched a returned rate and which bids were left off the comparison

evidence.claim: Bid administration is a schedule plus a price table. The negotiation itself is a meeting and stays with the people in the room.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. Prices on the comparison are copied from the returned bid, not written by a model.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the signed recommendation and the notice register. Awarding the contract is the procurement officer's act.

Input contract: package id, item code, signed quantity, estimate rate, bidder id, returned rate. Producer of quantities is the signed schedule. Producer of rates is the bidder. A return with no item code stays off the comparison.
Use the procurement register and the spreadsheet totals that already exist before custom code. The meeting prior is accepted for the negotiation and rejected for the schedule, which is document work.
A coded check of drawings is a different task. It is not used here to score, rank or award a bid.
unknowns: Who may recommend a bidder when the engineer is absent.
Which clause changes need a lawyer rather than the engineer.
research_questions: What share of returned rates has no item code?
How often does an addendum change the comparison after the first issue?

already_counted.description: Engineer checks quantities the schedule could not match
Negotiation time stays in the room
The recommendation signature stays with the engineer

incremental.description: Keep item codes and clause ids aligned when a new contract form is used
Bidders resubmit returns that have no item code

approvals.approved_version: bidder recommendation signed for this package id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes bids stay as unstructured mail, so the comparison is still built by hand and the negotiation is unchanged. The high case assumes item codes join cleanly, while every exception and the recommendation stay with the engineer. Award time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less of the week goes to rewriting repair notes, scenario tables and bid schedules, and the site call, the scenario choice and the negotiation stay with the transportation engineer.
reach: Maintenance leads receive the signed repair close-out instead of a verbal all-clear.
Development planners receive the signed scenario note with each figure tied to an output row.
Procurement officers receive the bidder recommendation only after the price comparison is filed.
skills_to_grow: Record a defect as an asset id, a method and a crew before the site visit.
Tie every scenario figure to a model output row and refuse a note that invents one.
Separate a bid price table from the negotiation that still has to happen in the room.
role.ambitious_version: Each open repair has a signed close-out, each scenario note cites output rows, and each negotiation starts from a filed price comparison.
